Hi Patricia / Tom —

Thanks for the details. I've reviewed Alex's draft and attached a tracked-change PDF (Meridian_ChangeOrder_redline.pdf). Key points to note:

1) Billing/proration (Sec 2):
   - Redwood standard approach is to prorate on a daily basis for partial months.
   - Meridian's request to cap proration exposure is understandable; we can discuss a compromise below.
2) Term and termination (Sec 4):
   - We propose leaving the MSA termination provisions unchanged; the change order will not create a special early-termination right tied only to the supplement.
3) Indemnity/data handling:
   - No changes recommended to data-handling exhibit; please confirm SSO/KMS key references if you need changes.

Suggested compromise for billing/proration (commercial): prorate only if supplemental capacity is terminated within the first 60 days; otherwise full-month billing applies. If Meridian prefers proration for partial first month only, note that will affect July billing.

Please review the redline and indicate commercial acceptance so we can finalize.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
